text:
Situation: Corvale East has 14.6 days of pegfilgrastim 6mg/0.6ml syringe on hand. Corvale General holds three lots totaling 207.44 units with 17.2 to 33.4 days of supply depending on the lot. Our labeled product is manufactured by Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (FEI 3011289655).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1038740 of the Kashiv plant ended on 2018-01-26 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI); that classification became known to FDA on 2018-02-16 per an FMD-145 letter. The most recent inspection (1241763) ended on 2024-06-14 and was classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Pegfilgrastim is not listed on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers near-term demand at both campuses. No shortage is declared by FDA. The Kashiv facility's most recent inspection resulted in a VAI classification. Alternative manufacturers are available but none appear on FDA's shortage list and their labels do not identify manufacturing sites we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue purchasing from Kashiv BioSciences while monitoring FDA inspection outcomes — buyer approves.
2. Qualify Accord BioPharma, Inc. as a secondary source pending label verification of manufacturing site — buyer and P&T committee approve.
3. Qualify Biocon Biologics Inc. as a secondary source pending label verification of manufacturing site — buyer and P&T committee approve.
4. Qualify Coherus Oncology, Inc. as a secondary source pending label verification of manufacturing site — buyer and P&T committee approve.
5. Qualify Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as a secondary source pending label verification of manufacturing site — buyer and P&T committee approve.
6. Qualify Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc as a secondary source pending label verification of manufacturing site — buyer and P&T committee approve.

Not recommended: Switching products or altering clinical protocols based on current supply status.
